xt:description.h1: Antenna House Formatter Area Tree XML File
xt:description.p: Non-normative documentation and schema for Antenna House Formatter AreaTree XML.
xt:description.pre:
# AreaTree 7.5.5
- Added `anchor-area`, `document-info.display-doctitle`, `expansion-text`, `text-treat-as`, `text-overflow`, `keep-together-within-inline-dimension`, `font-feature-settings`, `layer`, `border-connection-form`, `text-stroke-color`, `text-stroke-width`, `printer-marks-over-content`, and `outline-external-destination`. - `annotation-type` values `Highlight`, `StrikeOut`, `Underline`, and `Squiggly` - `leader.rule.style` values `wavy`, `double-wave`, and `double-wavy`. - `alttext`, `box-decoration-break`, `display`, `display-role`, `font-face`, `image-orientation`, `next-continued`, `prev-continued`, and `title` available on more elements. - `background-color` and `background-setup` optional on `TableRowGroupArea`. - `pdftag` can be empty with 'new-tagging-mode' (https://www.antenna.co.jp/AHF/help/en/ahf-optset.html#new-tagging-mode). - Enumerated values for `row-group-type`. - `row-number` is decimal. - `z-index` can be `auto`. - Corrected some allowed values.
